verdicts.reason: A reads in a sensible left-to-right order (logo, phone, headline, CTA), but the two-line legal text is stacked under the '25% off' line at almost the same size, which crowds the centre block. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an illegible sliver squeezed onto the top of the CTA, and the logo and phone are too tiny to read. B is worse: the legal fine print opens the banner at the far left, as large as the secondary copy, so it competes with the headline and buries the logo above it. Its ribbon sits on the edge of the phone in a collision, and the headline wraps awkwardly ('day last' alone on the second line), which leaves uneven gaps across the strip.
